name: marvel-cosmic-invasion-castle-doom-mode
note: رسمي: Dotemu and Tribute Games revealed the Castle Doom game mode (26 Oct, Gematsu 16:04Z; Steam DLC page 5032670) for the paid DLC The Siege of Castle Doom, out 10 Nov (date known since 8 Oct; the mode is today's news): run-based, Battery Cells, 12 perks, routes, a Siege Gauge; Doctor Doom and the Invisible Woman playable. Footage: Steam Game Mode Trailer (1080p), shots clear of its Italian captions and the end slate.
lines:
في إضافة Marvel Cosmic Invasion
القادمة يوم 10 نوفمبر

يجمع فيه اللاعبون الطاقة
ويختارون من 12 ميزة

ومعها شخصيتا Doctor Doom
و Invisible Woman للعب
